header.title: Muse computing ontology
header.description: Execution, command, process, filesystem, stream, status, and resource concepts for deterministic tool and runtime formalization.

definition.text: An arithmetic expression value formed by source-explicit addition.
A numeric value explicitly presented as approximate rather than exact.
An information artifact/value supplied as an input parameter to a program, command, or tool invocation.
A numeric value represented by an unevaluated arithmetic expression whose operands and operation are source explicit.
A situation representing source-established state/content metadata of an artifact at a specified point, interval, or event-relative role; it is distinct from the artifact's enduring identity.
A data value representing one of the two boolean truth values.
An execution outcome reporting that an operation was cancelled before normal completion.
An information artifact specifying an operation to be invoked, including command text or structured method identity distinct from its execution.
A process-execution occurrence initiated from a command specification.
A physical or virtual system capable of executing programs and maintaining computational state.
An abstract scalar or structured data value used as exact computational input, output, status, or metadata content.
A numeric value denoting a finite decimal/rational decimal quantity.
An execution outcome reporting that execution/effect was denied by policy, permissions, or an explicit gate.
An event in which an executing program or tool emits a diagnostic information artifact.
A filesystem object that organizes named filesystem entries.
An arithmetic expression value formed by source-explicit division.
An information artifact binding an environment variable/name to a value for an execution context.
A situation/configured environment providing the runtime conditions under which software is executed.
A situation/status attributed to an execution occurrence by an observed or reported result.
An information artifact/value reported when a process execution terminates, distinct from independent verification of requested external effects.
An execution outcome reported as failed with respect to the execution protocol's success criterion.
A filesystem object that stores a sequence of content bytes or equivalent file content.
A filesystem operation that creates a distinct filesystem object whose initial content is derived from another object.
A filesystem operation that creates a new file identity or filesystem entry.
A filesystem operation that removes a filesystem entry or makes the referenced object no longer present at that path.
A filesystem operation that changes the filesystem location/name of a file or directory while preserving the moved object's intended identity where supported.
A filesystem operation that observes file content or metadata without itself entailing a write.
An artifact state representing the content/metadata state of a file at a specified point or interval.
A filesystem operation that requests or performs a change to file content or metadata.
A digitally represented object addressable through a filesystem namespace.
An action that reads, creates, changes, relocates, copies, or deletes filesystem state.
A numeric value denoting an integer.
An execution outcome reporting that an operation began but was interrupted before normal completion.
A quale carrying an explicit numeric magnitude and unit of measure.
An arithmetic expression value formed by source-explicit multiplication.
A distinguished data value representing an explicit null/no-value token in a structured protocol.
A numeric value denoting a source-specified interval with explicit lower and upper numeric bounds.
A data value with mathematical numeric denotation; transport spelling is not part of its semantic identity.
A software system that manages computer resources and provides execution services to programs.
An execution outcome reporting that only part of the requested or attempted operation completed.
An information artifact denoting or attempting to denote a filesystem location through a path expression.
A ratio value explicitly presented as a percentage.
A vague numeric scale expression such as thousands or millions that denotes an order/scale without asserting one exact cardinality.
A temporally extended occurrence of executing a program or command under a computer execution environment.
A process-execution occurrence that requests execution of a particular program with supplied invocation parameters.
A numeric value represented as an unevaluated ratio of a numerator numeric value to a nonzero denominator numeric value.
An information artifact recording resource consumption associated with an execution occurrence.
An execution outcome reporting that an operation was not attempted because the source protocol skipped it.
A stream artifact emitted through an invocation's standard-error channel.
A stream artifact supplied through an invocation's standard-input channel.
A stream artifact emitted through an invocation's standard-output channel.
An information artifact emitted to or consumed from a process stream.
A data value whose exact computational representation is a character string.
A data value representing an ordered array or key/value object preserved in canonical structured form.
An arithmetic expression value formed by source-explicit subtraction.
An execution outcome reported as successful with respect to the execution protocol's success criterion.
An abstract unit used to interpret an explicitly measured magnitude.
An execution outcome token whose protocol-level status is preserved without assigning a stronger success/failure interpretation.

comp:afterArtifactState.definition: Relates an event to an artifact state explicitly identified as following/resulting from that event/effect.

comp:approximateNumericValue.definition: Relates an explicit approximation value to the exact numeric value around which the source expresses approximation.

comp:argumentName.definition: Relates an invocation-argument artifact to its source-level parameter name; the object is represented as a literal value in occurrence documents.

comp:argumentValue.definition: Relates an invocation-argument artifact to its losslessly preserved source-level value; the object is represented as a literal value in occurrence documents.

comp:arithmeticLeftOperand.definition: Relates an arithmetic expression value to its left operand.

comp:arithmeticRightOperand.definition: Relates an arithmetic expression value to its right operand.

comp:beforeArtifactState.definition: Relates an event to an artifact state explicitly identified as preceding that event/effect.

comp:copyDestinationObject.definition: Relates a copy operation to the distinct filesystem object established or observed as the copy destination.

comp:copyDestinationPath.definition: Relates a copy operation to the path expression supplied or resolved as its destination.

comp:copySource.definition: Relates a copy operation to the filesystem object whose content/state is used as source when source-object identity is established.

comp:copySourcePath.definition: Relates a copy operation to the path expression supplied/resolved as its source.

comp:createPath.definition: Relates a file-creation operation to its requested/resolved destination path without by itself asserting successful object creation.

comp:createsObject.definition: Relates a creation operation to the filesystem object created when creation is observed/established.

comp:deletePath.definition: Relates a deletion operation to the path expression it targets without asserting that an object exists at the path.

comp:deletesObject.definition: Relates a deletion operation to a filesystem object whose identity is established as its target.

comp:durationMillis.definition: Relates a process execution to a source-reported elapsed duration in milliseconds represented as an integer data value.

comp:emitsDiagnostic.definition: Relates a diagnostic-emission event to the diagnostic information artifact emitted.

comp:environmentHasBinding.definition: Relates an execution environment to one of its explicit environment bindings.

comp:exitCodeValue.definition: Relates an exit-status artifact to the exact source-reported numeric exit code represented as a literal.

comp:hasArgument.definition: Relates an invocation occurrence to an explicitly supplied invocation argument.

comp:hasExitStatus.definition: Relates a completed process execution to its reported exit status.

comp:hasFileState.definition: Relates a file to a represented state/version of that file.

comp:hasReportedOutcome.definition: Relates an execution occurrence to an outcome status explicitly reported by its source/protocol.

comp:hasStandardInput.definition: Relates a process execution to standard-input content supplied to it.

comp:inputArtifactState.definition: Relates an event to an artifact state explicitly used as an input state.

comp:intervalLowerBound.definition: Relates a numeric interval to its lower bound.

comp:intervalUpperBound.definition: Relates a numeric interval to its upper bound.

comp:invocationHasEnvironmentBinding.definition: Relates a process execution to an environment binding explicitly supplied for that invocation.

comp:invokesCommand.definition: Relates a command invocation to the command information artifact that specified it.

comp:invokesProgram.definition: Relates a program invocation to the program whose execution it requests.

comp:measurementMagnitude.definition: Relates a measurement quale to its explicit numeric magnitude.

comp:measurementUnit.definition: Relates a measurement quale to its explicit unit of measure.

comp:moveDestinationObject.definition: Relates a move operation to the filesystem object established or observed at its destination.

comp:moveDestinationPath.definition: Relates a move operation to the path expression supplied or resolved as its destination.

comp:moveSource.definition: Relates a move operation to its source filesystem object when source-object identity is established.

comp:moveSourcePath.definition: Relates a move operation to the path expression supplied/resolved as its source.

comp:observedArtifactState.definition: Relates an event to an artifact state observed in association with that event when no narrower before/after/input/output role is established.

comp:outputArtifactState.definition: Relates an event to an artifact state explicitly identified as an output state.

comp:pathDenotes.definition: Relates a filesystem path expression to the filesystem object it denotes in a particular resolved context.

comp:pluralScaleBase.definition: Relates a vague plural-scale value to its source-grounded numeric scale base.

comp:producesStandardError.definition: Relates a process execution to standard-error content it emits.

comp:producesStandardOutput.definition: Relates a process execution to standard-output content it emits.

comp:ratioDenominator.definition: Relates a ratio value to its source-grounded nonzero denominator.

comp:ratioNumerator.definition: Relates a ratio value to its source-grounded numerator.

comp:readPath.definition: Relates a filesystem read operation to the path expression it attempts/resolves for the read without asserting filesystem-object existence merely from the path string.

comp:readsObject.definition: Relates a filesystem read operation to the filesystem object it reads when object identity is established.

comp:resourceUsageOf.definition: Relates a resource-usage record to the execution occurrence whose consumption it reports.

comp:runsOn.definition: Relates a process execution to the computer system on which it executes.

comp:stateDigest.definition: Relates an artifact-state situation to an exact source-reported content/state digest represented as a string data value.

comp:stateOfArtifact.definition: Relates an artifact-state situation to the artifact whose state it represents.

comp:streamContent.definition: Relates an execution-stream artifact to exact captured stream content represented as a literal.

comp:underEnvironment.definition: Relates a process execution to its execution environment.

comp:workingDirectory.definition: Relates a process execution to the directory used as its working directory.

comp:writePath.definition: Relates a filesystem write operation to the path expression it targets without asserting that a filesystem object already exists at that path.

comp:writesObject.definition: Relates a filesystem write operation to the filesystem object whose state it attempts or performs a change upon when object identity is established.
